Things I've built

A selection of ML, full-stack, and applied AI projects — from healthcare risk prediction to handwriting analysis.

Featured

Cognitive Load Detection via Handwriting Analysis

Detects Low / Medium / High cognitive load from handwriting images using 15 graphological features — pen pressure, slant deviation, tremor index, baseline drift, and Shannon entropy — extracted purely from pixel geometry with OpenCV. An XGBoost classifier (with StandardScaler normalization) flags results as Normal, Slightly Elevated, or Abnormal based on task type, served through a Flask web app.

PythonOpenCVXGBoostFlaskHTML/CSS/JS

Healthcare ML

Candida Auris Infection Risk Intelligence System

ML-based system predicting Candida auris infection risk from patient data using LightGBM, with feature engineering on imbalanced medical datasets and results delivered through a Flutter dashboard.

PythonLightGBMFlutter
